messages:
sana_ml: Flagging odd behavior in orion-lite:v2 int4 bringup. Multilingual evals show small but consistent quality dip on zh->en and ar->en after quant. Suspect detok/token merge + bidi bracket flips.
li_zhang: can you share a couple of failing lines so I can tell if it's tokenization or generation?
sana_ml: two representative dev samples below (from deduped dev split):
```
src: 我今天去了公园，看到一只孩子在放风筝。
ref: I went to the park today and saw a child flying a kite.
int4_out: I went to the park today and saw a kid fly a kite.
float_out: I went to the park today and saw a child flying a kite.
```
```
src: ...أما بعض الأشخاص فقد تراجعوا عن قراراتهم.
ref: ...and some people backtracked on their decisions.
int4_out: ...and some people withdrew from their decisions.
float_out: ...and some people backed out of their decisions.
```
li_zhang: first looks like brevity / article drop; second is verb strength shift. Any token id/vocab changes in this onboarding?
dave_infra: tokenizer.json unchanged (v3). Build notes: int4 used PTQ static ranges and runtime v1.0.2 kernelset; float baseline used runtime v0.9.8. We did land a kernel ordering change in v1.0.x.
eva_qc: token-level diffs show a higher rate of han grapheme merges at punctuation boundaries in int4 outputs; detok length decreases slightly on average. I uploaded token alignment CSVs to CI.
toni_localization: also spotted mixed RTL/Latin lines where parentheses ended up mirrored after detok in some int4 runs. Example below: 
```
src: قال "(This is a test)" أمام الجمهور.
ref: He said "(This is a test)" in front of the audience.
int4_out: He said "(This is a test)" in front of the audience.
float_out: He said ")This is a test(" in front of the audience.
```
toni_localization: float run produced mirrored parentheses in that sample; behavior is inconsistent across runs.
sana_ml: my working hypothesis: quantization + kernel reorder nudged greedy logits so punctuation/space tokens differ at boundaries; the detok/postprocess bidi heuristics then flip orientation in some mixed-direction cases. Could be kernel change in runtime v1.0.2.
li_zhang: I'll add flags to tools/repro_multilang.py to dump token ids, pre-detok token sequence, and forced-detok variants (postproc_v1/postproc_v2) so we can identify whether model sequence or detok causes mirror.
dave_infra: I'll run a kernel-bisect: int4 on runtime v0.9.8 kernels and int4 on v1.0.2 to compare. Kicked job 84011. Logs: https://ci.internal/84011
ci-bot: Job 84011 started: orion-lite int4 runtime=0.9.8 kernelset=stable.
eva_qc: in parallel, I'm aggregating top-300 zh/ar diffs and computing chrF with & without punctuation normalization to measure impact on user-visible score.
li_zhang: repro command I'll use:
```
python tools/repro_multilang.py --model orion-lite:v2 --quant int4 --dump-tokens --force-detok postproc_v1,postproc_v2
```
li_zhang: that will let us run same token sequence through both detok variants.
dave_infra: preliminary: int4 on runtime v0.9.8 reduces zh->en BLEU delta from ~1.1 to ~0.15. So kernelset seems to be main factor.
sana_ml: good signal. Action: block kernel rollout for int4/v1.0.2 until kernel team patches ordering. For hosted we canary older kernel. For Dedicated/Private allow pin.
eva_qc: filing regression ticket ML-3310 with sample list + artifacts: https://redwood/issues/ML-3310
toni_localization: I'll add a small bidi/parens smoke to evals/locale/bidi_parens.json and a CI smoke that runs on onboarding jobs.
li_zhang: pushing repro + unit tests in a small PR, will reference ML-3310. ETA EOD.
dave_infra: starting kernel diff now and will prepare rollback patch if no blockers.
sana_ml: summary: (li) repro + test, (dave) pin/rollback kernels & bisect, (eva) attach metrics + severity, (toni) add bidi smoke. Keep thread open until patch. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: Issue ML-3310 created by eva_qc. Link: https://redwood/issues/ML-3310
